name: Matter.js
role: 2D rigid-body physics (JS); step it manually with a fixed delta to replay frames from t
summary: 2D rigid-body engine for bodies, constraints, collisions and composites, with an optional built-in canvas renderer. For VCR skip Matter.Runner: call Engine.update(engine, 1000/fps) with a constant delta and read body positions. To render frame f in any order, rebuild the world and step f times, or pre-bake every frame's transforms in one pass and look them up. Pure JS, small, repeatable in the same browser build.
use_when: Simple 2D falling, stacking or bouncing bodies drawn in Canvas 2D, PixiJS or SVG
Over Rapier 2D when you want zero WASM init and a tiny API
Pre-baking body transforms per frame into JSON for a seekable timeline
avoid_when: Large piles, 3D, or snapshot/restore: Rapier is faster and has takeSnapshot
Cross-machine reproducible results: Rapier documents an opt-in determinism mode
Hand-keyed motion with no collisions: GSAP
notes: 2026-10-26: Repo was pushed 2026-09-30 but the last npm release is 0.20.0 (2024-06-23); commit substance not inspected, so maintenance is rated slow. Determinism is not documented upstream; the fixed-step replay recipe is VCR's own and unverified.

assessment.rationale: No release in 28 months though the repo saw a push on 2026-09-30; MIT; adequate for small 2D scenes. Rapier is faster and better documented for determinism but heavier.

evidence.result: 90 distinct 1280x720 alpha frames at 30 fps; all shuffled hashes equal sequential; frame 45 alpha min 0 max 1. matter-js 0.20.0, Playwright 1.64.1, Chromium 156.0.8078.4, Node 22.19.0; screenshot route. Contact sheet of six frames inspected: bodies fall, land and settle.
evidence.scope: Boxes and circles re-simulated per seek with fixed 1000/60 ms steps, drawn by Canvas 2D; alpha PNG; macOS arm64 Chromium. No Matter.Render/Runner, sleeping, collision events or cross-machine equality.
